children: Nordex will significantly upgrade its earnings outlook, giving the stock significant upside potential after an excessive selloff, Bank of America analysts write. The onshore wind turbine manufacturer company will benefit from increased German demand and an uptick in U.S. orders, they say. The group's adjusted Ebitda margins will rise above 12% in 2027, the analysts expect, one percentage point ahead of current consensus estimates. In Germany, the rise of the AfD is a potential headwind for Nordex given the far-right party's opposition to onshore wind, they say, though risk is currently manageable. Bank of America upgrades its rating from neutral to buy for Nordex. Shares jump 12%, leading the Europe-wide Stoxx 600 index. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
